title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Images 1, 3–6 and 8; potassium.jsx Callout circle and leader over the ECG strips
findings.title: Light-theme callouts lose contrast on the monitor
findings.problem: The annotation stroke uses --accent-ink (#0A5A4E) against --mon (#0C201D), giving approximately 2.1:1 contrast. The U-wave ring is particularly difficult to distinguish. This fails even the 3:1 benchmark for meaningful graphics, as well as the project's stricter contrast requirement. The label contrasts adequately against white; its ring and the leader portions inside the monitor do not.
findings.fix: Give annotation portions over the monitor a contrasting light stroke or halo using the existing palette. Keep labels and leader portions over the white background dark. Verify contrast against the actual monitor background in both themes.

assessment: Fix the light-theme ECG annotations before publication. No confirmed clinical classification error was found in the supplied potassium logic.
